text: Mtoto mdogo anacheza mpira uwanjani leo.
gloss: The small child is playing ball in the field today.

text: Mama alipika chakula kitamu na tukala pamoja jana usiku.
gloss: Mother cooked tasty food and we ate together last night.

text: Di pikin dey run go house because rain wan fall.
gloss: The child is running home because it is about to rain.

text: Yaron yana wasan kwallo a filin makaranta.
gloss: The boy is playing ball on the school field.

text: Wanafunzi wawili walisoma vitabu vitatu katika maktaba kubwa.
gloss: Two students read three books in the big library.

text: She buy two big fish for market yesterday.
gloss: She bought two big fish at the market yesterday.

text: Ndege wanaruka juu angani wakati wa asubuhi.
gloss: The birds fly high in the sky during the morning.

text: Mun tafi kasuwa domin sayen sabon tufafi jiya.
gloss: We went to the market to buy new clothes yesterday.

text: Rafiki yangu anapenda kusoma na kuandika mashairi marefu.
gloss: My friend likes to read and write long poems.

text: Dem don finish the work, so everybody happy well well.
gloss: They have finished the work, so everyone is very happy.
